data.content_ref: inline:015994869366 inherits from SRC_001: a checklist's genuine reliability reduces to the frozen mapping's causal completeness, which an adversarial in-distribution probe (SRC_002) can only partially decouple because constructing adversarial items requires prior knowledge of the very structure the checklist is meant to encode. This is refuted if any single-evaluation method — adversarial or process-based — is shown to uniquely determine causal completeness without cross-distribution testing.
